metadata.title: Build for RBI, Inherit the EU AI Act — Regulatory Cross-Walk
metadata.author: Pratik Dhanave (AI Architect, ClearRoute)

rbi_draft_mrm.name: RBI Draft Model Risk Management Guidance

rbi_free_ai_recommendations.scope: Shared AI infrastructure / regulator enablement
Regulated Entity AI adoption & foundational governance
Indigenous financial datasets & public digital infrastructure
Data governance, lineage & residency controls
AI Innovation Sandbox / regulatory experimentation
Internal testing, validation & sandbox readiness
Sector-wide capacity building & AI Centre of Excellence
Organizational AI literacy, training & operational readiness
Inter-regulatory coordination
Sectoral code of conduct (SRO)
Supervisory AI toolkit & regulatory oversight
Sectoral incident intelligence sharing
Regulatory framework alignment & periodic review
Board-approved AI policy (declarative policy YAML)
Data privacy, residency per message & append-only consent ledger
Risk classification & tiering enforced before dispatch
Governance approval lifecycle & runtime drift guard (ErrRiskChanged)
Consumer transparency & AI disclosure on first event
Explainability & mandatory rationale for advice/decisions
Red-team corpus executed on every PR
Third-party / vendor model accountability & controls
Tamper-evident SHA-256 hash-chained audit log & Annexure VI incident reporting
Full model/agent inventory generated from live registry
Continuous monitoring, guardrails & deterministic fallbacks
Customer grievance redressal & first-event AI disclosure
Auditability, independent assurance & verifiable evidence packs

rbi_to_eu_crosswalk.notes: SHA-256 chain anchored to external timestamp; reports broken chain transparently

rbi_to_eu_crosswalk.control: Annexure VI incident form (RBI prescribed AI-incident report)

rbi_to_eu_crosswalk.notes: Pre-dispatch enforcement including ErrRiskChanged drift guard
Accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity regression gate
EU AI Act Article 50 has been binding law since 2 August 2026
Versioned, board-approved Quality Management System configuration

rbi_draft_mrm_scorecard.requirement: Full model inventory, nothing running outside it
Risk tiering by materiality, complexity and autonomy
Accountable for a vendor's model, certified or not
Inventory kept 10 years, including decommissioned models
